political-intro-nations.alt: Four small diagrams. A nation-state: one box (a state) filled with one kind of shape (one nation), close to it is Iceland. A multinational state: one box with three kinds of shapes, for example Nigeria. A multistate nation: one kind of shape spread over two boxes, for example Koreans in two states. A stateless nation: one kind of shape spread across three boxes with no box of its own, for example the Kurds.
